avis.titre: Great product! My dry skin's holy grail!
avis.texte: I picked this up when my skin was flaking from winter + retinol, and wow. This is true intense hydration without feeling greasy or heavy. What I love: • Texture: Thick but sinks in fast. No sticky film, no pilling under makeup. • Relief: Instantly calms that tight, itchy dry feeling. My redness was down by day 3. • Ingredients: Colloidal oatmeal + shea butter combo is perfect for my sensitive skin. Fragrance-free = no irritation. • Lasting power: Actually keeps my skin hydrated for 24 hours. I wake up still soft, not dry. Results after 2 weeks: Skin barrier feels stronger, no more flaky patches around my nose/chin, and makeup sits way better. Even my eczema-prone spots stopped freaking out. Worth noting: A little goes a long way. The tub is huge and lasts months. If your skin is oily, maybe use as a night cream only. But for dry/dehydrated/sensitive skin? 10/10. Would repurchase forever. This replaced 3 other moisturizers in my routine.

avis.titre: A Lifesaver for Rosacea Flares & Irritation
avis.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've known about First Aid Beauty for a while, so I was excited to receive this jar for free to test out. I have very dry skin and diagnosed rosacea that flares up severely. While testing this, I actually had a bad rosacea flare and hives (unrelated to this product). Even with my skin being that irritated, this cream was incredibly effective, and had no negative impact on my skin during this sensitive time. The consistency is a perfect whipped texture that sinks in quickly. It actually felt really nice and had a slight cooling sensation on my "hot" skin. I'd highly recommend to anyone with rosacea, or dry sensitive skin. I've been using it for several weeks on my face, neck, and hands. The first morning after trying it, my skin was visibly glowing. It's also been wonderful for healing irritated spots; I noticed that after cleansing, applying this dramatically decreased the inflammation and redness of my pimples. I think the combination of the colloidal oatmeal and the eucalyptus is what helps so much with that. One thing to note is the scent. While it's labeled unscented, Eucalyptus Globulus Leaf Oil is listed as the last ingredient, and it is immediately noticeable—reminding me of Noxzema. Because of that oil, I wouldn't advise using this on a truly damaged or "raw" skin barrier, as it might sting a little at first. However, on my typical dry/sensitive skin, it has been great. I was excited to give the First Aid Beauty Ultra Repair Cream a try after seeing it hyped up on various social media platforms as being great for sensitive and eczema prone skin. Sadly, this product did not work for me. As soon as the product touched the skin on my hands and face, I immediately felt a tingling and burning sensation that continued to intensify and irritate even after I washed it off. Based on my experience, I am very surprised that this product is labeled as being accepted by the National Eczema Association and is marketed as being suitable for sensitive skin. I suspect that this untoward reaction was likely due to the eucalyptus oil. I would describe the texture and consistency of this cream as being comparable and very similar to Noxzema which I tried as a teenager, and leaves the skin with that same tingling and burning sensation even after being rinsed off.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I love First Aid Beauty's products because as the name suggests, they're truly a first aid and life saver for my skin especially just coming out of winter. My hands, feet and body have been super dry and irritated. I love lathering this on my hands and body after showering. It's a super thick consistency but blends in smoothly and easily into my skin and keeps it very hydrated for a long time. I have acne prone and sensitive skin so I wouldn't use something super heavy on my skin but if you have dry skin, it will probably be really soothing and hydrating for it. This also doesn't have a scent so that's good if you have sensitive skin to fragrances.
